title: Musa, Part 8: The Sea Splits
fact_notes: No number of people, place name, or crossing detail beyond the verses is claimed.

lines.text: Pharaoh's army behind them, the sea in front. Nowhere left to run.
lines.spoken: Pharaoh's army behind them, the sea in front. Nowhere left to run.

lines.text: Allah had inspired Musa: "Travel by night. You will be pursued."
lines.spoken: Allah had inspired Musa: "Travel by night. You will be pursued."

lines.text: Pharaoh sent gatherers to the cities: "They are only a small band."
lines.spoken: Pharaoh sent gatherers to the cities: "They are only a small band."

lines.text: At sunrise, his army set out after them.
lines.spoken: At sunrise, his army set out after them.

lines.text: When they saw each other, Musa's people cried: "We will be overtaken!"
lines.spoken: When they saw each other, Musa's people cried: "We will be overtaken!"

lines.text: Musa said: "No! My Lord is with me. He will guide me."
lines.spoken: Musa said: "No! My Lord is with me. He will guide me."

lines.text: Then Allah inspired him: "Strike the sea with your staff."
lines.spoken: Then Allah inspired him: "Strike the sea with your staff."

lines.text: The sea split apart, each side like a great towering mountain.
lines.spoken: The sea split apart, each side like a great towering mountain.

lines.text: Allah saved Musa and all who were with him.
lines.spoken: Allah saved Musa and all who were with him.

lines.text: Pharaoh followed with his soldiers, and the sea covered them.
lines.spoken: Pharaoh followed with his soldiers, and the sea covered them.

lines.text: Drowning, he cried: "I believe!" Allah said: "Now? After you disobeyed?"
lines.spoken: Drowning, he cried: "I believe!" Allah said: "Now? After you disobeyed?"

lines.text: His body was saved, a sign for all who come after.
lines.spoken: His body was saved, a sign for all who come after.

lines.text: Next, Musa seeks a man given knowledge he did not have. Follow for Part 9.
lines.spoken: Next, Musa seeks a man given knowledge he did not have. Follow for Part nine.
